info.title: algoERP API
info.description: Multi-tenant Accounting & Inventory ERP SAAS — REST API. Clean, structured, resource-oriented endpoint architecture with transaction orchestration, double-entry GL/Stock validation, and granular RBAC authorization.

bearerAuth.description: Provide JWT token in Authorization header: `Bearer <token>`

success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful

message.description: Optional status message or success message

data.description: The payload returned by the server

details.description: Detailed errors (e.g. Zod validation failure details)

description.example: Handles sales invoices and delivery notes

401.description: Invalid credentials or inactive user account.

post.description: Verifies the provided refresh token and issues a new JWT access and refresh token pair.

get.description: Returns the profile details of the user associated with the bearer token.

post.description: Updates the user password after verifying current password.

400.description: Incorrect current password or new password validation failure.

post.description: Logs out the user, auditing the event.
